technique_name: Write a description of the biggest galaxy in the universe.
description: The largest known galaxy in the universe is IC 1101, which is located about 1.07 billion light-years away from Earth. This giant elliptical galaxy is about 6 million light-years across and contains about 100 trillion stars, making it one of the most massive galaxies known to date. Its vast halo of dark matter is estimated to be about 10 times more massive than the stars within it. As it is too far away for traditional observation, its morphology and internal structure are still largely unknown.
